title: Most Frequent Number Following Key In an Array
summary: Given a 0-indexed integer array nums and an integer key that appears in nums, count how many times each unique integer target immediately follows the key.
statement: Given a 0-indexed integer array nums and an integer key that appears in nums, count how many times each unique integer target immediately follows the key. Specifically, count the number of indices i where 0 <= i <= nums.length - 2, nums[i] equals key, and nums[i + 1] equals target. Return the target with the highest count, ensuring this target is unique.
constraints: Inspect indices i only through len(nums)-2 where nums[i] equals key.
Count the immediately following value nums[i+1].
The input guarantees one target has a unique highest count; return that target.
hints: Only adjacent pairs beginning with key contribute.
Scan every index that has a successor and count that successor when the current value is key.
Build a Counter from nums[i+1] for matching i, then return the key with maximum count.
The comprehension represents exactly every required occurrence, and the guaranteed unique maximum removes tie ambiguity.
editorial: The comprehension represents exactly every required occurrence, and the guaranteed unique maximum removes tie ambiguity.

tests.explanation: Value 100 follows key 1 twice and is the unique most frequent target.
Two follows the key three times while three follows it once, so return two.
